project.name: AI短视频脚本平台 · 科技感
project.styleDefinitionBrief: Retro-futuristic dark theme: deep navy-black bg (#08090d), cyan/mint primary (#06d6a0), electric blue accent (#4cc9f0), Inter font, neon border glow effects, grid background pattern, glassmorphism cards, AI creative tool aesthetic
project.designRead: AI creative tool / content creators / retro-futuristic tech trust / medium density / avoid purple neon or generic blue SaaS

colorSystem.primaryColorRole: cyan/mint #06d6a0 for primary CTA, active states, neon glow borders, and AI accent
colorSystem.brandHuePolicy: single cyan primary hue; electric blue #4cc9f0 as secondary accent for info/highlights only

styleContinuityAnchors.typographySystem: Inter for all text; JetBrains Mono for data values
styleContinuityAnchors.componentLanguage: dark glassmorphism cards with neon border glow, grid background pattern, subtle scanline effects
styleContinuityAnchors.surfaceAndDepth: neon-border static surfaces; glow shadows for primary emphasis; deep shadows only for floating layers
styleContinuityAnchors.imageryAndIconography: minimal decorative imagery; neon-outlined icons; video thumbnails with glow border on hover
styleContinuityAnchors.interactionTone: smooth 200-300ms transitions, glow pulse on key elements, subtle hover lift

sharedProjectShellContract.navigationShell: top navbar with glassmorphism bg, logo with glow, pill-style nav items, credits badge, action buttons, user avatar
sharedProjectShellContract.primaryColorSystem: cyan/mint #06d6a0 primary; electric blue #4cc9f0 secondary accent
sharedProjectShellContract.typographySystem: Inter display + body; JetBrains Mono for data; tight tracking for headings
sharedProjectShellContract.surfaceDepthModel: neon-border cards; glow effects on primary elements; shadow only for modals/dropdowns
sharedProjectShellContract.ctaStyle: gradient primary buttons (cyan→blue) with glow hover; ghost secondary buttons with neon border
sharedProjectShellContract.alignmentRules: left-aligned content; centered video grid; grid-based card layout
